parameters.name: EffectiveBandwidthFilter
parameters.description: Filters results by the actual effective bandwidth value. Only positive integers are allowed. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no next query exists.
- If a value is returned for **NextToken**, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: TrafficQosPolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the traffic scheduling policy.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueDescription
parameters.description:
The description of the traffic scheduling policy queue.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueId
parameters.description: The ID of the traffic scheduling policy queue.

parameters.name: TrafficQosQueueName
parameters.description:
The name of the traffic scheduling policy queue.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.description: The ID of the inter-region connection.

parameters.name: TransitRouterId
parameters.description: The ID of the transit router instance.
